newsitem.title: USA: Manor Care to offer to buy Vitalink stake.
newsitem.headline: Manor Care to offer to buy Vitalink stake.

text.p: Health care provider Manor Care Inc said Friday that its board of directors had authorized a tender offer for up to 1.5 million shares or about six percent of Vitalink Pharmacy Services Inc.
Manor Care, which already owns about 11.5 million shares or 45 percent in the institutional pharmacy company, said the tender price will be $20 a share.
It said it will begin the offer on April 24.
Manor Care said the offer would raise its stake in the company to more than 50 percent, "enabling Manor Care to consolidate Vitalink for financial reporting purposes," it said.
On February 12, Vitalink completed a merger with TeamCare, an institutional pharmacy subsidiary of GranCare Inc, it said.
The transaction reduced Manor Care's ownership in Vitalink to 45 percent from 82 percent, it said.
Vitalink's stock, which was temporarily halted on the New York Stock Exchange early Friday, was trading at 18-1/2 against a close of 17-1/2 the previous day.
